dct_title_s: Elephant Lake Quadrangle, Minnesota-St. Louis County, 1967: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Elephant Lake quadrangle topographic map (N4807.5-W9237.5/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in ink and pencil regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the Elephant Lake area of the Kabetogama State Forest. The hand written notations include information on the following logging camps noted with 'C'.
